userdoc.notice: Uniswap v2 cumulative-price oracle over the canonical NET/USDG         pair. `checkpoint()` is permissionless with a minimum 30-minute         spacing (CHECKPOINT_MIN_INTERVAL); `Staking.rebase()` also         checkpoints each 8h epoch. A TWAP read is valid ONLY over a window         between TWAP_MIN_WINDOW (30 min) and TWAP_MAX_WINDOW (4 h):         outside the band every dependent operation fails closed — the         Distributor mints nothing, InverseBond and PremiumSeller refuse to         settle. Spot price is never used; anyone can revive a stale oracle         with one poke plus a 30-minute wait.
